newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy Nov 24-25 0.5-pct diesel.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy Nov 24-25 0.5-pct diesel.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 0.5 percent sulphur gas oil (diesel) and jet fuel for November 24-25 delivery, traders said on Thursday.
Traders said that this was the first time CPC has requested 0.5 percent sulphur diesel, instead of its usual 1.0 percent.
The tender seeks 160,000 barrels of diesel and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel for two-port delivery to Colombo and Trincomalee on a cost-and-freight basis.

The best offer to CPC's last tender to purchase 130,000 barrels of diesel was at $1.45 per barrel over Singapore spot quotes, and 70,000 barrels of jet fuel was at $1.07 premium to Singapore quotes, for November 14-15 delivery c-and-f Colombo, traders said.
The tender closed on October 23 with offers valid unit October 25.
